mapper.select: SELECT frame_sn FROM bike_vehicle WHERE vehicle_qr_code=#{qrCode} OR vehicle_qr_token=#{qrCode}
WHERE v.frame_sn=#{frameSn} GROUP BY v.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.id,p.part_sn,p.part_type,p.status,p.bind_status,p.current_frame_sn FROM bike_part p JOIN bike_vehicle_part_binding b ON b.part_id=p.id WHERE b.vehicle_id=#{vehicleId} AND b.part_type=#{partType} AND b.is_current=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,part_sn,part_type,status,bind_status,current_frame_sn FROM bike_part WHERE part_sn=#{partSn} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_rework_part_detail(rework_id,part_type,old_part_id,old_part_sn,new_part_id,new_part_sn) SELECT id,#{partType},#{oldPartId},#{oldPartSn},#{newPartId},#{newPartSn} FROM bike_rework_record WHERE rework_no=#{reworkNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_vehicle_part_binding SET is_current=0,unbind_time=NOW(3),unbind_reason=#{reason},unbind_operator_id=#{operatorId} WHERE vehicle_id=#{vehicleId} AND part_type=#{partType} AND is_current=1
UPDATE bike_part SET bind_status='BOUND',current_vehicle_id=#{vehicleId},current_frame_sn=#{frameSn},status='IN_USE' WHERE id=#{partId} AND status='AVAILABLE' AND bind_status='UNBOUND'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM bike_rework_record WHERE rework_no=#{reworkNo}

SELECT v.vehicle_qr_code,r.id,r.rework_no,r.frame_sn,r.reason,r.status,d.part_type,d.old_part_sn,d.new_part_sn,r.operation_time FROM bike_rework_record r LEFT JOIN bike_vehicle v ON v.id=r.vehicle_id LEFT JOIN bike_rework_part_detail d ON d.rework_id=r.id WHERE r.id=#{id}

SELECT v.vehicle_qr_code,r.id,r.rework_no,r.frame_sn,r.reason,r.status,d.part_type,d.old_part_sn,d.new_part_sn,r.operation_time FROM bike_rework_record r LEFT JOIN bike_vehicle v ON v.id=r.vehicle_id LEFT JOIN bike_rework_part_detail d ON d.rework_id=r.id ORDER BY r.operation_time DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_vehicle SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{vehicleId}
